step_outcomes.notes: SCOPE DISCLOSURE: The plan specifies 5 seeds; I am running 3 seeds (42,1,2). This is MY decision, governed by the replication directive's explicit '~8-10 GPU-h on ONE GPU' target and '>=3 seeds' guidance, to leave compute for the other steps (esp. the 20B neox step). 3 seeds still yields mean+/-std. DTYPE DISCLOSURE: GPT-J run in fp16 (repo default is fp32) as a deliberate efficiency choice; validated below. DIRECTIVE/NNSIGHT: Per the directive, I implemented the FV per-head activation extraction (reading transformer.h[L].attn.out_proj.input) AND the FV-add intervention (transformer.h[L].output[0][:,-1] += fv) in nnsight (src/nnsight_validate.py) and validated them against the baukit path on antonym: extraction matches to 0.056% relative error (mean|diff|=6.7e-5 vs baukit mean-abs 0.12); antonym L9 zero-shot FV top-1 = 0.490625 identical via BOTH baukit and nnsight (clean 0.009375 both). The full-scale grid numbers are produced via the repo's baukit path (proven ground truth); the CIE patching loop stays baukit as the directive explicitly permits. Which path produced each number is documented here: all reported accuracies=baukit(fp16); nnsight cross-check=antonym only, matches exactly.
